offering_description.value: Stride provides online K–12 schooling and career education to students, public schools and districts. It delivers instruction through virtual classrooms and supplies schools with digital curricula, learning platforms and operating support. It also offers online career certification training to adults.

primary_products.value: digital K–12 curricula; online courseware; learning management software; instructional materials

primary_services.value: online K–12 instruction; virtual school management; K–12 career and technical education; adult career certification training

customer_segment.value: B2G: public school districts and public virtual charter schools; B2C: families paying private school tuition and adults seeking career credentials; B2B: private schools, employers and workforce training organizations

end_markets.value: public K–12 education; private K–12 education; career and technical education; adult workforce training

revenue_model.value: project or contract: public school agreements for instruction, curriculum and school operations, often priced by enrollment; licensing or royalties: school access to digital curricula and learning software; service fees: tuition for private online schooling and adult career training
revenue_model.category: project or contract; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: combines educators, curricula and administrative staff to deliver virtual schooling and career training; software / platform: develops digital courses and learning tools for schools, teachers and students

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States, with private online schooling available internationally

specialization.value: related lines: virtual K–12 schooling, school curriculum and software, career and technical education, and adult certification training

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: public school districts and charter schools offering Stride-supported programs; direct sales: school and district administrators purchasing curricula, software and program services; online: web enrollment for families and adult learners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state virtual school, charter and funding rules, plus federal student privacy requirements

notes: The current lineup of adult training programs is uncertain.
